subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram — full agent activity visibility (Web UI parity)

question: Should Telegram gain a persistent per-step activity-message mode, and if so what redaction, retention, and configuration policy should it use?
rationale: Current main intentionally uses transient editable progress previews and sanitized browser-local Activity summaries; making Telegram persist every activity step changes disclosure, chat transcript retention, message volume, and public config behavior.

options.title: Design redacted opt-in mode
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved Telegram mode only after specifying safe defaults, redaction rules, allowed step types, retention semantics, and live Telegram proof requirements.

options.title: Keep current progress previews
options.body: Close or defer this direction and keep Telegram on editable progress drafts plus the final answer, avoiding durable disclosure expansion.

options.title: Create shared observer API first
options.body: Track a broader channel-safe observer stream/API before adding Telegram-specific persistent rendering, so Web UI, TUI, and Telegram do not drift.

recommendation.title: Design redacted opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved Telegram mode only after specifying safe defaults, redaction rules, allowed step types, retention semantics, and live Telegram proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the Telegram progress window, docs, and adjacent activity behavior makes this the best available routing candidate.
